jobs.name: three_table_left_fence
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id LEFT JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id AND c.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: three_table_join
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 AND c.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: left_then_inner
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a LEFT JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id AND b.bucket<>3 JOIN items c ON c.id=b.id WHERE a.id=$1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: three_left_chain
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a LEFT JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id AND b.bucket<>3 LEFT JOIN items c ON c.id=b.id AND c.bucket<>5 WHERE a.id=$1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: four_left_middle
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label, d.bucket FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id LEFT JOIN items c ON c.id=b.id AND c.bucket<>3 JOIN items d ON d.id=a.id WHERE a.id=$1 AND b.id=$1 AND d.id=$1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: four_left_chain
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label, d.bucket FROM items a LEFT JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id AND b.bucket<>3 LEFT JOIN items c ON c.id=b.id AND c.bucket<>5 LEFT JOIN items d ON d.id=c.id AND d.bucket<>7 WHERE a.id=$1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: full_fallback
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id FULL JOIN items c ON c.id=b.id WHERE a.id=$1 AND b.id=$1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: function_fallback
jobs.sql: SELECT abs(a.id), b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id LEFT JOIN items c ON c.id=b.id AND c.bucket<>3 WHERE a.id=$1 AND b.id=$1 ORDER BY a.id
